$comment: Regression gate thresholds (#8). A metric regresses only if BOTH rel (fraction of baseline median) AND abs (metric units; bytes for memory/size, ms for time) are exceeded. First matching class wins; metrics matching no class (counts) are not gated. 'disarmed' cells are report-only: shown in the PR table, never fail. Baseline = median of the last `baseline_n` main entries with the same key and the same host+Chrome.
